spec.name: Madreperla Piano Accordion
spec.description: A 34-key Italian piano accordion lying on its back, in pearly celluloid (madreperla) with a black pleated bellows, a chrome and gold grille, and ruby and sapphire studs.
spec.layout: The accordion lies on its back with the long axis along Z, stored half-open. From the front (+Z) to the back (-Z): the piano keyboard facing +Z, the treble box (z 0.10..0.30, 0.46 wide, 0.26 tall), 14 black pleats of bellows (z 0.10 to -0.20, tapering from 0.43 to 0.37 wide, y 0.01..0.25), then the bass box (z -0.20..-0.30, 0.38 wide) with its bass-button board on the rear -Z end. The treble box and the bass box rest on y=0. The chrome and gold treble grille and the register switches sit on the treble top face, and the small bass grille sits on the bass top face. The bellows hang about 1 cm above the floor. Model right (-X) is the player's right hand; the register panel is on the +X end. STYLE: every pearl surface is a mosaic of thin 4-5 mm tiles in the pearl tints, seated on a pearlWhite base. Tile mix: 40% pearlWhite, 20% pearlCream, 15% pearlPink, 10% pearlBlue, 8% pearlMint, 7% pearlLilac, with 1 mm gaps showing pearlShade. All edges are bound in chrome rods. Corner caps and studs are gold, with ruby and sapphire gems. The bellows are glossy black with pearl corner tapes and gold ridge lines. The keys are ivory-white and black. Chrome is used for grilles, rails, button rims and buckles. Every part uses the same tile mix, the same chrome rod radius (0.0025) and the same gem sizes (radius 0.005 on cases, 0.008 on medallions). No joints; the model is static. To save part count, merge small same-colour pieces per part (mergeGeometries, with b.part at [0,0,0] and a bone-less root).

parts.builds: The right-hand (treble) box shell, 0.46 wide (x), 0.26 tall (y), 0.20 deep (z), as a pearlWhite base box with the mosaic of thin tiles in the shared tint mix on the top border (the frame around the grille zone), on both end faces (+X, -X), on the front wall z=0.30 beside and above and below the keyboard zone, and on the bottom plate. The bottom plate has a black leatherLight back panel with a chrome edge and four small chromeDark domed feet flush on y=0. The rear wall at z=0.10 is the plain pearlShade bellows mounting frame, a 0.43 x 0.24 opening outlined by a bellowsFold rim, for the bellows to meet. Chrome edge binding rods run along all 12 box edges. Gold corner caps (small chamfered cubes) sit on the 8 corners. A gem stud (ruby on the -X end face, sapphire on the +X end face, each in a goldBright ring) sits at the centre of each end face, with a pearlShade groove line around it. On the -X end face, a gold oval escutcheon plate carries a small engraved fleur motif made of goldDark strips. On the front wall, a 0.39 x 0.14 recessed keyboard window (y 0.06..0.20, x -0.195..0.195) is filled with a keyBlack felt slab at z 0.30, as backing for the keys. Do not build the grille, registers, keys or rails.
parts.attaches: Rests on the floor. Its rear face at z=0.10 meets the bellows at trebleBellowsFace. Its top face at y=0.26 carries trebleTop. Its front face at z=0.30 carries the keyboard at keyboardBed.

parts.builds: Everything on the treble top face (y 0.26..0.30, z 0.10..0.30). (1) The treble grille: a raised chrome frame plate, x -0.19..0.15 and z 0.12..0.28, over a grilleDark backing slab. Inside it, 11 slender chrome ribs fan out from the frame's -Z end and curl at their tips. Chrome scroll tendrils (spiral sweeps) fill the four corners. A central oval gold medallion at grilleCenter has a goldDark rim, a ruby gem in the middle (radius 0.008) and four small sapphire gems around it, with goldBright filigree dots. A goldBright border line and gold rivets run round the frame. (2) The register panel at x 0.175..0.225, z 0.12..0.28: a pearlCream strip with a chrome edge, carrying 6 rocker switches in a row along z. Each switch has a chrome base, a keyWhite rocker that is tilted slightly, and a tiny keyBlack dot, plus a gold nameplate. (3) A small gold plaque reading as the maker's brand, with 5 keyBlack dashes as letters, and a pearlPink and pearlBlue marquetry flower of 5 petals next to the grille at x=-0.21 as accent. All items stay within y<=0.30 and sit seated on the case top at y=0.26.
parts.attaches: Sits on trebleCase's top face (caseTopY, y=0.26). The grille is centred at grilleCenter. The register panel is at registerPanel.

parts.builds: The piano keyboard on the front wall of the treble box, facing +Z. 21 ivory keyWhite keys, each 0.0176 wide (x), 0.14 long (y, from 0.06 to 0.20), 0.016 deep (z, z 0.30..0.316), on a 0.0186 pitch from x=-0.195 to 0.195, with a 0.0010 gap between them (keyEdge slim lines on the front lip). 15 keyBlack keys, 0.011 wide, 0.075 long (y 0.125..0.20), z 0.30..0.328, centred on the boundary after white keys 0,1,2,4,5 of each 7-key octave (the sequence starts at F). A chrome lower key rail (y 0.035..0.06, z 0.30..0.325) with a feltRed felt strip on its upper face, and an upper rail (y 0.20..0.235) that is pearlCream with a chrome edge and carries a gold nameplate at the centre (x -0.05..0.05) with goldDark engraved dashes. The key cheeks, at x ±0.195..±0.23 and y 0.04..0.23, are pearlCream blocks with small gold rivets and a sapphire stud at each top. Highlight: a very thin keyWhite shine strip on every black key's top.
parts.attaches: Sits on the front wall of trebleCase at keyboardBed (z=0.30). The rails align to keyRailLow and keyRailHigh. It touches nothing else.

parts.builds: The pleated bellows between the boxes, from z=0.10 (trebleBellowsFace, 0.43 wide x 0.24 tall) to z=-0.20 (bassBellowsFace, 0.37 wide x 0.24 tall, y 0.01..0.25). It has 14 pleats of pitch 0.0214 in z. Each pleat has an outer peak ring (dimensions interpolated between the front and rear sizes, +0.012 on width and height) and an inner valley ring (-0.014 on width and height), joined by sloping bellowsBlack slabs on all 4 sides (top, bottom, +X, -X). The valley slabs alternate with bellowsFold for a glossy shaded look. A thin feltRed liner band sits in each valley groove. At the 4 corners of each peak, a pearlWhite corner tape (small angled strip) forms a continuous zig-zag along each corner edge, with a goldBright stud at each peak corner. A thin gold line runs along the middle of every other peak ridge on the top and bottom faces. The front and rear end pleats are capped with a chrome-bound bellowsFold frame plate 0.004 thick. A chrome-and-leather bellows latch strap hangs at the +X side near z=-0.15, with chrome buckle.
parts.attaches: Its front end meets trebleCase's rear face at trebleBellowsFace, and its rear end meets bassBox's front face at bassBellowsFace. It does not touch the floor.

parts.builds: The left-hand (bass) box, 0.38 wide (x), 0.26 tall (y), 0.10 deep (z, z -0.20..-0.30). It is a pearlWhite shell with the same pearl tile mosaic (shared tint mix) on its top border, both sides (+X, -X), the bottom and the front wall, with chrome edge binding and 8 gold corner caps, plus a ruby stud on each side face in a goldBright ring. Its front wall at z=-0.20 is a pearlShade bellows mounting frame with a bellowsFold rim, 0.37 x 0.24 opening at bassBellowsFace. The rear wall, z=-0.30, is a bass-button board: a chrome-bound black keyBlack board (x -0.14..0.14, y 0.035..0.225) with a grid of 6 columns by 8 rows of round buttons (radius 0.0085, protruding to z=-0.315), alternately keyWhite and keyBlack by row, each in a thin chrome rim, the buttons in the middle row marked with a gold dimple. The board's rail strips are pearlCream with gold rivets. On the top face (y=0.26) there is a small bass grille, 0.16 x 0.07: a chrome frame, grilleDark backing, 7 chrome slats and a gold medallion (radius 0.012) with one sapphire gem, up to y=0.285. On the bottom there is a black leather back plate with 3 chromeDark feet on y=0. A leather bass strap (leather, with leatherLight stitch lines and a chrome buckle) loops over the bass-box side at +X (x up to 0.20) at bassStrapAnchor.
parts.attaches: Rests on the floor. Its front face at z=-0.20 meets the bellows at bassBellowsFace. The bass strap hangs from bassStrapAnchor.

I'm settling on the accordion's footprint and pose: I'll have it stand on the bass-end feet with the long axis running along X and the keyboard facing toward the viewer. I'm sizing it at roughly 0.62 wide, 0.46 tall, and 0.27 deep, and I'm still working out how the keyboard should face once it's standing rather than held.

I'm working out which way the player's right lines up with the model's axes, so the treble box ends up on the correct side.
